variables.body: Hi HelpHub team, I hope you're doing well. I'm writing because I have a question about my recent invoice and the subscription charges that appeared on my credit card statement. I've been a customer for about two years now, and I've always been on the Pro plan which is $49 per month. Last month I noticed there were two charges of $49.00 on my card for March, and I'm not sure why that happened. I didn't make any changes to my subscription, I didn't upgrade or downgrade, and I certainly didn't authorize a double charge. I've checked my account settings and everything looks normal there, still showing the Pro plan at $49/month. I also looked at my invoice history and there's only one invoice for March, which is correct. But my credit card statement clearly shows two separate charges of $49.00 both dated in March. Could you please look into this and let me know what happened? I'd really appreciate it if you could check the billing system and see if there was some kind of error or duplicate charge. If it was a mistake, I'd like to get a refund for the extra charge. Thanks so much for your help, Priya

input_messages.content:
You are the ticket router for HelpHub, a customer support platform.
Classify the customer's ticket into exactly one queue:

- billing: charges, invoices, payment methods, subscription pricing
- shipping: delivery status, tracking, delays, lost parcels, address changes
- returns_refunds: returns, exchanges, damaged or wrong items, refund requests
- technical_support: bugs, errors, integrations, API and webhook problems
- account_access: login, password reset, two-factor, locked or compromised accounts
- general: anything else, including feedback, partnerships and sales questions

Reply with the queue name only, exactly one of: billing, shipping, returns_refunds, technical_support, account_access, general. No punctuation, no explanation.
